items.text: Rams listed Puka Nacua QUESTIONABLE for MNF vs Giants (hip/groin soreness); no practice Fri/Sat, McVay notes pre-game decision, unrelated to camp psoas.
items.why: Hip injury + post-Thursday groin soreness; Whittington doubtful (quad).
items.implication: Monitor closely; start if active with pivot ready for MNF.
items.opportunity: If OUT, TE usage (Ferguson/Parkinson) and Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields bump.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring. Previously doubtful/path from ETR board.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 1; DNP then limited, downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Sit Flowers; Lamar Jackson volume shifts to remaining WRs/TEs.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes open for Bateman/Walker/Andrews; red-zone to Andrews.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT vs Patriots with foot injury.
items.implication: Sit Pittman; PIT WR depth thins further.
items.opportunity: Targets to Metcalf/others; Germie Bernard extended look per Levitan.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) on ETR Sunday injury board; confirmed across reports after DNP practices and Grade 1 strain.
items.why: Hamstring tweak mid-week; history of multi-game absences.
items.implication: Sit Collins; HOU WR room thinned, Stroud targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel; Schultz TE bump.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE (back) but expected to play; Burrow said missing would be ridiculous, Taylor positive.
items.why: Back soreness; full practice Friday, coach/player positive.

items.text: Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White with Brock Bowers DOUBTFUL for Sunday.
items.why: Injury limiting; elevations signal low play probability.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate, impacting Justin Herbert projections heavily; game at 4pm ET. QJ/Harris inherit large roles if out.
items.why: Ribs; limited practice, affects multiple projections.
items.implication: Biggest slate Q; monitor for Herbert/WR volume shifts.
items.opportunity: Johnston/Harris 22%+ tgt shares possible if McConkey limited/out; cheap WR volume.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers (AJ Brown IR), unclear vs Stevenson but 10+ touch potential with nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go; NE needs explosives, favorable stretch before bye.
items.implication: Monitor for committee share; upside in debut.
items.opportunity: 10+ touches possible; handcuff/ upside over Stevenson floor.
items.conflict: Unclear how much at Stevenson expense.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN on ETR board after full practices; expected back from MCL, squeezes Etienne/Miller RBBC from Week 1 9-carry splits.
items.implication: Kamara reclaim role; Etienne passing-game squeeze as underdogs.
items.opportunity: Kamara touches/routes; fade Etienne per Berry hate.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) Q status still matters for SF RB splits.
LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps), 40% route targets Week 1; IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite utilization + soft run matchup; 24% tgt share career-high territory.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; massive season upside if healthy.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization Week 1 (tied Bijan), 19% tgt share last 10, 25+ touches 3/4 recent.
items.why: Workhorse usage under Kubiak; overreaction to prior injury scare.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util, 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches Week 1; out-routed Gainwell; CLE soft vs RBs.
HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Miller rushes Week 1, 69% pts via air; Kamara return squeezes further as 8.5-pt underdogs.
items.opportunity: Negative for Etienne; positive reverse for Kamara.
